title: One chest for the whole realm
text:
The Bloodsand Chest is now the same chest for everyone.

🔧 Every player in the arena sees the same Bloodsand Chest. When someone loots it, it disappears for everyone, and a new one appears 30 minutes after it was looted
🔧 The realm decides who reached the chest first, so two players can no longer both claim it, and players who join later see the same chest or the same countdown
• The arena panel shows how long until the next chest and who looted the last one
